design.transaction_boundary: Stage CSV/Parquet and manifest in caller-owned temporary output root; atomic publish of verified immutable version directory. No PostgreSQL or canonical account writes.
design.idempotency_and_recovery: Hash canonical content independent of Parquet bytes; exact repeat returns same dataset version; conflicting logical bar requires explicit versioned correction. Orphan staging is not a published dataset.
design.error_and_unknown_semantics: Reject missing mapping, ambiguous listed contract, unqualified coverage, malformed timestamps, contradictory duplicates and traversal. Missing calendar intervals never become zero missing bars.
compatibility_rules: Reuse accepted MarketObservation identity and versioned calendar interfaces through adapters.
Preserve existing storage/readers and backtest imports; do not migrate existing data/ or accepted models.
public_semantic_gaps: Exact quality-policy registry/schema and correction precedence must be frozen with field-level examples before execution.

parallel_or_parked_work: P02 contract workspace can progress independently after P00 acceptance.

positive_examples: D01 identical CSV with reordered records yields same semantic dataset identity
D02 night-session fixture has calendar trading date distinct from UTC date
D03 explicit corrected child version preserves parent run reproducibility
counterexamples: D04 conflicting duplicate without correction policy rejects
D05 unknown contract/calendar or insufficient coverage rejects
D06 staging crash/hash mismatch never publishes visible dataset
regression_impact_set: storage readers, accepted observation identity and calendar consumer tests selected by exact changed contracts
independent_review_scope: canonical hash framing and correction lineage
unchanged accepted source/data and bounded output location

acceptance_checks: All D01-D07 fixtures linked to test results and exact candidate commit
No canonical runtime authority or data/ writes
Independent review and integrated acceptance required; compiler success is not acceptance
stop_conditions: P00 baseline not independently accepted or exact package grant missing
Versioned quality contract/source mapping not frozen
Final source baseline drift requires fresh compilation
